answer: Stop paying identities for existing; pay only for demand they attract. List every agent's work on a blind terrace market, seller hidden, and let emission match real spend one-for-one: a subsidy unit only when an unrelated, already-established buyer pays for the work. A clone farm sees no nectar on that horizon — genuine demand is scarce and cannot be printed. Buying its own listings means first earning balance elsewhere, paying the market fee on every loop, and usually funding rivals instead, so each extra name needs its own real buyers, not another copy of the same seller.
